lu-jia.oneLineEn: Early Han political essayist who, in New Discourses, explained Qin's fall and civil order.

lu-longqi.oneLineEn: Early Qing Cheng-Zhu scholar-official known for honoring Zhu Xi, lecturing, and local governance.

lu-xiujing.oneLineEn: Southern Dynasties Daoist who organized Lingbao scriptures and the Three Caverns catalog system.

luo-congyan.oneLineEn: Song Neo-Confucian linking Cheng disciples to Li Tong and Zhu Xi's lineage.

luo-rufang.oneLineEn: Late Ming Taizhou figure known for childlike conscience, daily teaching, and popular lecturing.

lyotard.oneLineEn: The postmodern condition and the end of metanarratives.

maine-de-biran.oneLineEn: Inner experience of effort and will opened French spiritualism; links Descartes to Bergson.

malebranche.oneLineEn: Occasionalism and 'seeing all things in God' moved Cartesianism into theological metaphysics.

mao-qiling.oneLineEn: Early Qing classicist known for broad evidential debate and anti-Zhu readings of the Four Books.

maria-lugones.oneLineEn: Argentine-born feminist whose coloniality of gender advanced decolonial feminism.

maurice-blanchot.oneLineEn: Literary space, the neuter, and disaster writing; after Levinas and Bataille.

maurice-blondel.oneLineEn: Philosophy of action; fills modern French Catholic thought and pre-phenomenology.

max-scheler.oneLineEn: Phenomenological value ethics after Husserl on value and personhood.

michael-dummett.oneLineEn: Theory of meaning and anti-realism; Frege interpretation and later analytic philosophy.

michael-oakeshott.oneLineEn: Practical knowledge and critique of political rationalism; fills British conservative philosophy.

michel-henry.oneLineEn: Phenomenology of life; non-Heideggerian French phenomenology.

michel-serres.oneLineEn: Philosophy of the third/parasite between science and the humanities.

miguel-de-unamuno.oneLineEn: Tragic sense of life and faith anxiety; Spanish prehistory of existentialism.

milarepa.oneLineEn: Kagyu yogin whose songs represent Tibetan practice literature and liberation narrative.

mipham.oneLineEn: Nyingma Rimé figure whose Madhyamaka and pramāṇa commentaries shape modern Tibetan systematics.
